feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The best raced design is iteration 6 (score 683.7): base_speed 0.9, kp 1.4, kd 0.5, sensors at y 0.07, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss last_direction. Iteration 8 moved the sensors to y 0.075 and scored 671.4, below iteration 6. The slalom was unchanged at about 0.33 progress and the s-bend finished 20/20 but with more oscillation than at y 0.07, so y 0.075 is not the lever. Iteration 4 (kd 0.5, y 0.05, base 1.0) raised slalom progress from 0.17 (kd 0.4, iteration 2) to 0.31, which is the only evidence that damping moves the slalom. The same change cost s-bend finishes (17 to 15 of 20), and moving the sensors to y 0.07 (iteration 5) recovered them to 19 of 20. This candidate is a single-variable step from the best design (kd 0.5 to 0.6, everything else as iteration 6), so any result change is attributable to kd. The off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + 0.12/4) = 0.06 m, so body width cannot help. The candidate is valid and at least as plausible as the best design, and there are enough runs left to race it. Approve it. After the race, read it as follows. If the oval and s-bend stay at 20/20 (s-bend oscillation at or below about 0.35) and slalom progress rises above 0.39, keep kd 0.6 and consider kd 0.7 next. If s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20 or s-bend oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return kd to 0.5, since damping has reached its useful limit at this speed. If the slalom stays near 0.39 with no change, the limit is the slalom's sharpest turn geometry, and the next probe should be a sensor span change rather than more gain.
requested_changes: If slalom progress rises above 0.39 while the oval and s-bend stay at 20/20 and s-bend steering_oscillation stays at or below about 0.35, keep kd 0.6 and test kd 0.7 at base_speed 0.9 and y 0.07. Iteration 4 showed kd 0.5 lifted slalom progress from 0.17 to 0.31.

If s-bend finishes fall below 18 of 20 or s-bend steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return kd to 0.5 with base_speed 0.9 and y 0.07. Iteration 4 (kd 0.5, y 0.05) dropped s-bend finishes to 15 of 20, and iteration 5 recovered them only at y 0.07.

If slalom progress stays near 0.39 with no finishes at kd 0.6, stop changing gains. The next probe should widen the outer sensors (x of ±0.040 m, staying within the ±0.08 limit) at kd 0.6, because iteration 8 showed that y lead does not move the slalom.
